task: Generate one photorealistic still frame in the style of a casual vertical selfie video: an original fictional woman talks to her audience from the driver's seat of her parked car. It will be used as the first frame of a talking-head video, so it should feel natural and authentic, like a frame from an everyday phone video.

output.look: natural phone front-camera video frame, not a professional photo

subject.identity: an original fictional Latin American woman, around 30 years old
subject.face: warm light-olive skin with natural texture (visible pores, tiny natural imperfections, faint expression lines), dark brown eyes, soft natural makeup, slight natural facial asymmetry
subject.hair: long dark brown hair with soft natural waves, parted slightly to one side, a few loose strands framing the face
subject.accessories: small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold necklace, no sunglasses

wardrobe.top: cream-colored knit sweater with a round neckline and long sleeves, soft fabric with natural folds, seatbelt fastened across her chest
wardrobe.style: elegant smart casual, professional and approachable, no visible logos

pose_and_expression.position: seated in the driver's seat of the parked car, facing the phone, leaning very slightly toward the camera
pose_and_expression.gaze: looking directly into the lens, making eye contact with the viewer
pose_and_expression.expression: calm, confident and friendly, a subtle natural smile, as if about to start talking; mouth closed or barely parted
pose_and_expression.hands: both hands resting relaxed on the lower part of the steering wheel at the bottom of the frame, natural fingers, correct anatomy

environment.location: inside a modern premium car, parked on a quiet street during the day
environment.background: cream leather seats with fine stitching, the headrest behind her, the side window and the rear seats softly visible, outside the windows a calm tree-lined street softly out of focus
environment.foreground: the top of a leather steering wheel at the bottom edge of the frame, slightly out of focus, without any brand emblem
environment.atmosphere: clean, tidy, real car interior, not a studio set

camera.device: phone front camera mounted on the dashboard near the windshield, at chest-to-eye height, slightly below eye level
camera.lens: wide-angle selfie lens (about 24mm equivalent) with its natural mild perspective
camera.framing: medium close-up from the waist up, subject centered horizontally; her head sits in the upper-middle of the frame (eyes at about 38% of the frame height from the top), leaving clean space with the car headliner above her head for on-screen graphics
camera.focus: face sharp, background softly in focus as a phone would render it (no artificial heavy bokeh)
camera.quality: 1080x1920 vertical video frame, slight sensor noise, true-to-life colors

lighting.key: soft, diffused frontal daylight coming through the windshield in front of her, lighting her whole face evenly; the car is parked in open shade, no direct sunlight
lighting.fill: soft ambient daylight reflected by the cream leather interior
lighting.mood: bright, clean and realistic; both sides of the face equally lit, no side shadows, accurate skin tones, low contrast

realism_rules: natural, authentic everyday phone video look, not a stock photo
natural skin texture, no heavy smoothing or beauty filter
natural fabric folds on the sweater
correct anatomy: two hands, five fingers each, natural proportions
natural catchlights in the eyes from the windshield
negative: text, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, UI elements
car brand emblems or badges, readable screens or dashboard text
side lighting, one half of the face darker than the other, harsh direct sunlight, strong shadows
studio lighting, ring light reflections, cinematic color grading, heavy bokeh
extra or deformed fingers, distorted hands, warped face
plastic skin, heavy makeup, 3D render, cartoon, illustration
the car in motion, motion blur, cluttered interior, other people
